correctness.rationale: Reconstructed total 3-cut definition on twelve vertices of C6×K2 (not ordinary cut). Independent source-separated enumeration found 76 independent triples, 3,762 augmented simplices with f-vector (12,66,220,495,792,924,792,384,76), and an elementary 1,870-pair staged matching. All 21,576 Hasse incidences topologically sorted without cycles; the ordinary matching has one critical vertex and 22 critical dimension-six simplices. Forman yields a CW complex with one 0-cell and 22 6-cells, hence a wedge of 22 six-spheres integrally; since the input is pure dimension eight the non-top homology forbids shellability. Independent full signed Lefschetz trace on all 24 D6×C2 automorphisms, exact rational character inner products, and dimension 22 reproduce multiplicities (χ++:4, χ-+:1, χ--:1, ρ1:2, ρ2:3) in + layer and (χ++:1, χ--:1, ρ1:1, ρ2:1) in − layer. τ has trace 10 and eigendim 16,6. GF2 ranks independently agree, but integral assertion derives from acyclic Morse, not GF2. All dimensions, quantifiers and normalizations match RESULT.md.

originality.rationale: Bounded best-of-knowledge originality PASS for the specific total three-cut homotopy AND rational D6×C2 homology character of C6×K2. Full original Bayer total-cut and Carnero Bravo 2026 manuscripts and a published circular-ladder three-cut theorem were compared by definitions. The circular-ladder theorem is ORDINARY cut (disconnected complement triples), while the submitted complex is TOTAL cut (independent complement triples). The group-character module is not implied by a mere Euler number or homology rank. The generic Morse algorithm itself is standard; only the exact finite topological and equivariant conclusions are considered. Search/self-hit is not novelty proof.
